title: Exec readout mini-pack: failure-mode-led mitigation lanes and targeted asks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: produce a compact, board/exec-ready mini-packet that centers on top failure modes for the inference platform and concrete mitigation lanes with resourcing asks. This ticket scopes content, stakeholders, and sign-offs for the March monthly exec readout. Outcome: a 4-slide packet and 2-page appendix that justify a targeted investment ask and define roll-forward triggers.
background: Recent incidents and SLO regressions across burst traffic and model rollouts exposed three recurring failure modes: 1) degraded tail latency during autoscaler cold-starts, 2) silent quality regressions when swapping quantized variants, 3) cross-regional fallback capacity shortages. Leadership has asked for a short readout with explicit asks and measurable triggers for escalation.
goals: Surface top 3 failure modes with root-cause summaries
Present 3 mitigation lanes with cost/benefit and kickoff owners
Request a single prioritized investment ask (12-month commit) and contingency triggers
agenda_for_readout: Slide 1: Executive summary and single ask
Slide 3: Mitigation lanes with resourcing and success metrics
Slide 4: Runway and decision timeline + fallback plan
Appendix: incident timelines, dashboards, PR links
decision_asks: Approve $750k incremental R&D reserve for autoscaler and kernel tuning work over next 4 quarters
Greenlight a pilot of dedicated warm-pool nodes for high-tier customers (Q2-Q3)
Sign off on rollback-safe model-variant registry policy and canary thresholds
metrics_and_signals: Tail P95/P99 generation latency by model class
SLO burn rate (% of minutes failing per week)
Quality delta for quantized vs full models evaluated on core prompt set
Fallback events per 10k requests by region
mitigation_lanes: Lane A: Autoscaler cold-start reduction - improve warm-pool heuristics + prewarm library (owner: Eng-SRE)
Lane B: Model-variant safety net - automated A/B canaries + gated rollback (owner: Applied ML)
Lane C: Cross-region capacity fabric - dynamic routing + prioritized queues for premium customers (owner: Infra)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Warm-pool increases cost; Mitigation: cost-offset by targeted traffic shaping and telemetry to disable for low-tier customers
Risk: Automated rollback could disrupt experiments; Mitigation: require model owners to provide regression tests and add automatic failsafe after 3x anomaly bursts
Risk: Capacity pilot may not show ROI quickly; Mitigation: pilot with 2 customers and a 60-day evaluation window
acceptance_criteria: 4-slide packet reviewed and approved by Eng manager and Head of Product
Appendix includes incident timelines and links to PRs and dashboards
Single investment ask crisply articulated with cost and success metrics
Packet uploaded to Confluence and shared with execs 48 hours prior to readout
